desc:
🎁 JOIN THE COMMUNITY SERVER FOR CODES AND UPDATES!

⚽ Build the ultimate footballer, one part at a time! ⚽

🌍 Roll a random nation from the 48 pro teams
🎲 Get a random star player from that squad
🧩 Take ONE part from them: Hair, Face, Torso, Arms, Left Leg, Right Leg, Left Boot or Right Boot
📊 Every part boosts a stat: Heading, Composure, Stamina, Physical, Pace, Shooting, Dribbling and Passing
🏟️ Lead your footballer through the tournament, YOU decide every move: pass, dribble or shoot!
✨ Pull SHINY parts and chase a 99 OVR legend
💰 Earn cash and climb the RANKS to become the GOAT!

👍 Like the game + favorite ⭐ to help support the game!

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: This is a fan-made, unofficial game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by FIFA or any national team.
